qsr-023.title: Safety goals in your role
qsr-023.lead: Hand hygiene and patient identification look different by role.

items.title: Every patient contact
items.body_html: Five moments at the point of care; two identifiers before every test, medicine or procedure. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: At registration
items.body_html: Two identifiers at check-in and on every phone booking; never the room number. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Behind the scenes
items.body_html: Clean hands on clinical floors; report anything unsafe you see, even outside your job. Proposed — SME to confirm.

append_html.qsr-092: As a {{role_label}}: report one near miss or unsafe condition the day you see it.
